translationRepairs: Huo Guang’s wife Xian and his daughters all had registry access to Changle Palace; some came and went through the edict gate by night, arrogant and unrestrained, and I fear they may gradually escape control.

Huo Guang’s wife Xian and his daughters all had registry access to Changxin Palace; some came and went through the edict gate by night, arrogant and unrestrained, and I fear they may gradually escape control.
Chinese 通籍長信宮 names Changxin Palace; Changle would be 長樂宮, so the palace-name correction is required.

Guang’s wife Xian and his daughters all had registry access to Changle Palace; some passed through the edict gate by night, arrogant, extravagant, and unrestrained—I fear they may gradually become ungovernable.

Guang’s wife Xian and his daughters all had registry access to Changxin Palace; some passed through the edict gate by night, arrogant, extravagant, and unrestrained—I fear they may gradually become ungovernable.
The literal likewise misrenders 長信宮 as Changle; Changxin is the accurate place name.

In Emperor Yuan’s time, Wu Zun of Chang’an submitted a memorial saying, ‘When your servant was young, I served as a petty clerk in the commandery residence and privately saw Emperor Xuan, then the imperial great-grandson, in the prison there.

In Emperor Yuan’s time, Chang’an commoner Zun submitted a memorial saying, ‘When your servant was young, I served as a petty clerk in the commandery residence and privately saw Emperor Xuan, then the imperial great-grandson, in the prison there.
士伍 is a status term, not surname Wu, and 尊 is Zun; the proposal’s appositive is ungrammatical, so render as ‘Chang’an commoner Zun’.

Chancellor Xiao He and Imperial Clerk Zhou Chang respectfully deliberated with General Liu Ling, Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent Shusun Tong, and others: The Son of Heaven’s clothing for spring, summer, autumn, and winter should model the numbers of Heaven and earth and attain the mean of human harmony.

Chancellor Xiao He and Imperial Clerk Zhou Chang respectfully deliberated with General Wang Ling, Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent Shusun Tong, and others: The Son of Heaven’s clothing for spring, summer, autumn, and winter should model the numbers of Heaven and earth and attain the mean of human harmony.
Chinese has only 將軍臣陵; Liu is invented and wrong. Yan Shigu identifies 陵 as Wang Ling, parallel to the other expanded names in this sentence.

Also in his heart he knew the heir apparent had no factual guilt; doubly he pitied the great-grandson’s innocence; Ji selected a careful and honest female convict, ordered her to nurture the great-grand grandson, and placed him in a quiet, dry place.

Also in his heart he knew the heir apparent had no factual guilt; doubly he pitied the great-grandson’s innocence; Ji selected a careful and honest female convict, ordered her to nurture the great-grandson, and placed him in a quiet, dry place.
Chinese 曾孫 is great-grandson; ‘great-grand grandson’ is a typographical duplication and must be corrected.
